description: Operationally informed forecasting of aggregated campus electricity demand: occupancy-aware stacking is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Sergio Sánchez Moragues, Zaid García Sánchez (Universitat de les Illes Balears). This dataset contains hourly data from the Son Lledó Campus of the University of the Balearic Islands (UIB), from 1 January 2023 to 31 August 2025. The file contains 23,376 hourly timestamps. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
